mcqs.question: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced which earlier legislation governing civil aviation?
mcqs.explanation: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 replaced the Aircraft Act, 1934. The Air Corporations Act, 1953 and the Open Sky Policy, 1990–94 were separate aviation measures, while the National Civil Aviation Policy was introduced in 2016.
